data.name: Death-Stealing Gaze
data.description: You gain the death-stealing gaze ability of a nabasu. You can activate this ability as a free action, and can use it for up to %1 rounds/day - these rounds need not be consecutive. The saving throw to resist this gaze is %2. Nabasu demons who gain this boon can use their death-stealing gaze at will, regardless of their total number of growth points.|3+CON,10+HD/2+CHA
